description.narrative: (Nigeria): With FY 2022 funds this activity will:.Deploy security resource tools, instant communication tools, site visits, training, and regular meetings to USAID Nigeria contractors and sub-contractors;.Assist with the effective delivery of U.S. government funded assistance; .Strengthen the ability of IPs to prepare for potential security incidents; and .Keep IPs abreast of security situations as they unfold in Nigeria. .USAID/Nigeria has established a Partner Liaison Security Operation (PLSO). The PLSO facilitates communications between USAID Implementing Partners (IPs) operating in Nigeria. PLSO allows IPs to effectively use and share publicly available security information, thereby improving their security situational awareness. The PLSO activity (supported by USAID's Automated Directives System (ADS) 573) is implemented in countries identified as high threat posts, such as Nigeria..PLSO produces weekly activity reports for the Mission and USAID/Washington on security incidents throughout the country. This activity permits all FY 2022 funded activities to implement with additional security resources and information at their disposal to reduce security incidents and help keep partners and staff safe..
